BackupJob.description: 202 means queued, not remotely durable. Only completed creates represent published backups. Failed/interrupted restores require inspection before a new explicit restore.

Document.description: Dynamic document; 1 MiB binary size, nesting 32, scalar indexed paths. _rev is forbidden in writes; use if_rev. Integer and floating point values remain distinct.

cursor.description: Only for from queries; bind the same query values.

statement.description: One DSL statement, at most 64 KiB UTF-8.

evidence_id.description: Administrator asserted reference, not independently verified evidence
Administrator asserted reference, not independently verified evidence
Administrator asserted reference, not independently verified evidence
Administrator asserted reference, not independently verified evidence

IdentityWrite.description: Requires admin, identity_write, or identity_correct. Manual correction requires admin or identity_correct. Same operation ID and authenticated actor must retry the identical request. Manual intervals require a reason. Actual expanded records and WAL bytes must fit configured atomic limits.

lookup.description: Optional default Lookup. Omit or use an empty string for a general immutable dataset.

version.description: Client publication request ID, not the resulting version. Use response.version to execute or replace.

ReadRequest.description: Batch queries require an absent cursor. Returned cursors retain this read snapshot.

expected_history.description: History captured with the read; required for positive if_rev and operation_id.

operation_id.description: Retry the identical request and token. Receipts expire after the tenant duration; expired requests must not be resubmitted with new tokens.

retry_token.description: Persist the issued token with the original request; never refresh it to retry.

info.description: Physically isolated tenant databases. Document writes acknowledge durable local WAL commits. Optional one-primary/one-replica asynchronous replication supports durable fencing, planned switchover and explicit externally fenced emergency promotion. Replica writes are rejected; replicated roots reject ordinary restore/import. Remote backup submissions return 202 jobs; only completed creates are remotely published. Index creation waits for READY or failure.
